question: Should v0.39.0 now be authorized for publication from signed tag object `b515d60cfd0e744bcb0cd4823311fba58e3a87e4` and source commit `f46ce01f42e7bc2ff8491fafb3074ebd27b52c4e`?
rationale: The repository intentionally separates source authorization from binary publication, so automation can verify identities but cannot decide whether maintainers intend to cross this release gate.

options.title: Verify and authorize
options.body: Confirm the signer and exact object identities, require the Release Check to pass, and then merge the ready record.

options.title: Keep publication blocked
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until the release artifacts or intended source identity are ready to authorize.

recommendation.title: Verify and authorize
recommendation.body: Confirm the signer and exact object identities, require the Release Check to pass, and then merge the ready record.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main release-preparation work and signed-tag history make them the best available owner for this release-inclusion decision.
